services.name: Boat Tours
services.desc: Enjoy 360º views of the mountains and learn interesting facts about the Town of Dillon and the Dillon Reservoir during a 1 & 1/2 hour pontoon boat interpretive tour of Lake Dillon. Hosted by the Dillon Marina and the Summit Historical Society, you are guaranteed to learn something about Dillon and Summit County that you hadn’t known before. Whether you're a history buff or just like the idea of relaxing out on the lake, it's a terrific way to spend a morning. Due to high demand, we offer these Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday every week from June 2nd- August 30st. We also offer them every second Saturday of June, July and August. services.name: Alpine Fishing
services.desc: Dillon Reservoir is a prime location for summer or winter fishing. The lake is home to Brown Trout, Rainbow Trout, Kokanee Salmon and Arctic Char. With 26 miles of shoreline, finding a nice secluded spot to cast is not a problem. The Mysis shrimp was introduced into Dillon Reservoir in 1970 as a food source to fatten trout and salmon. But the small nocturnal crustaceans missed the trout’s daytime feeding patterns and began eating all of the zooplankton - leaving salmon and trout hungry and small. services.name: Exit 205 Brewery Tour
services.desc: Whether you’re staying off Exit 205 or making a stop off I-70, Do Exit 205 Right with the Exit 205 Brewery Trail. Sip on locally brewed suds, soak in the views, and enjoy a snack or meal at one or all of these five breweries located in Dillon and Silverthorne, Colorado. We recommend starting up the hill in Dillon and ending in Silverthorne or reversing your self-guided brewery tour. Please enjoy responsibly and don’t drink and drive. Walk, bike or take advantage of the free Summit County bus service between Silverthorne and Dillon! blurb: Marina Park overlooks Dillon Reservoir and is surrounded by the Ten Mile and Gore Ranges. It offers lakeshore access, picnic tables with shades, a large updated playground, fishing opportunities, charcoal grills, and access to the Summit County Recreation Path around the lake. The Marina Park Pavilion is available for reservation and the park is open from sunrise until one hour after sunset for day use only.
